selection: One explicitly approved clean PNG, complete current case text and all customer corrections; no automatic image selection or truncation.

cohort_specification.reference_rule: Two independent human annotations for each question; adjudicate disagreement before the held-out model run. Freeze exact source hashes, approvals, references, role and stratum membership before any qualifying inference. No image or near-duplicate family may cross roles.

metrics.exact_question_agreement: Correct labels / all frozen question-image pairs; unavailable results count as failures, no denominator exclusions.
metrics.cannot_assess_recall: Predicted cannot_assess / all independently labeled cannot_assess pairs.
metrics.false_clear_rate: Predicted yes / all independently labeled no-or-cannot_assess pairs.
metrics.review_rate: Any cannot_assess or unavailable result / all frozen images, reported separately from incorrect factual labels.
metrics.strata: Report every metric and numerator/denominator by role and stratum, including missing/failed requests. Report confidence intervals; provider confidence is not calibrated probability.

proposed_thresholds.threshold_selection: Fixed before qualification; never tune on the held-out role. Thresholds are local proposed qualification targets, not accepted capability claims.

review_handling: All observations are advisory and require human review. cannot_assess and unavailable results explicitly retain manual handling. A reviewer can record a bounded disagreement without changing business records.
wire_fixture_role: Synthetic answers test transport and orchestration only. They provide no visual accuracy, safety, calibrated confidence or external-deletion measurement.
